text:
mira: rolled anchor-shelf reserve up to 13% at 08:57 UTC to reduce noisy preempts for pinned jobs. noticed a sudden rise in tiny-gang pending and preempt churn.

tony: which zone? any warm-pool activity?

mira: eu-west1. infra-bot kicked a warmpool scale a minute before the reserve change. new nodes weren't ready yet.

zhen: saw this pattern in staging last month. anchors act like hard taints and fragment GPU slots for gang-scheduled workloads.

infra-bot: [autoscaler] warmpool resize requested +12 nodes in eu-west1 (id wp/2026-03-22/77).

tony: paste a `kubectl describe` snippet for a pending pod?

mira: `Events: Warning FailedScheduling 2m default-scheduler 45/120 nodes are available: 38 Insufficient gpu, 7 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate.`

lucy: immediate mitigation: revert reserve to 8% and pause warm-pool scaling for 10m. we'll also throttle aggressive preemption loops.

zhen: additional short-term: run selective eviction of beam-worker best-effort pods that are scattering GPUs: `kubectl -n infra delete pod -l app=beam-worker --force --grace-period=0 --field-selector=status.phase=Running` in batches of 5.

mira: rolling reserve back to 8% now (08:59 UTC).

tony: for next time: add a canary (5m ramp) and a metric `gpu_fragmentation_index` to gate flips. also coordinate warmpool ops in same change window.

lucy: opened follow-up: runbook entry for "reserve flips" + gating metrics + quick `kubectl` queries to show taint/label heatmap.

mira: monitoring: pending gang count back to baseline after 9m. closing incident as mitigated, follow-ups assigned. :thumbsup:
